hooks.command:
FILE=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty')
if [ -z "$FILE" ]; then exit 0; fi
OUTPUT=$(node packages/cli/dist/index.js check --files "$FILE" --format json 2>&1)
if echo "$OUTPUT" | jq -e '.violations | length > 0' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "$OUTPUT" >&2
  exit 2
fi
exit 0
